Interface StreamingSubscription

All Known Implementing Classes:
StreamingSubscriptionWrapper
public interface StreamingSubscription
A streaming subscription (SubscriptionResponse in the spec). Describes the message types delivered, the single delivery channel, and lifecycle/audit metadata.
